manual.detail: The existing protected-main Genie warmer seeds the new nix6-genie-closure key after merge; old selective entries cannot satisfy it. Cold seeds and eviction still require upstream downloads. No Namespace quota, label, priority or runner change.

recovery.detail: An incomplete Genie shell cache fails the isolated restore control and is not published; no retries, skip or source-build fallback. Reverting the source restores the earlier selective cache policy and its public-fetch dependency.
